entities.name: Shafqat Rasool
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Shafqat Rasool is a Pakistani field hockey player. On 3 April 2021, he was banned from all competition for 10 years after "indulging in a fight during a match." However, the ban was lifted on 3 October 2021, by a fact-finding committee.
